core.title: Smooth Curve Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull, Omnia 9450
tags: Contemporary curved Kitchen cabinet door pulls

text.description_html:
Omnia 9450, Brushed Stainless Steel Smooth Curve Cabinet Pull

Ultra minamalistic in design, this stainless steel cabinet door pull made by Omnia is sure to add a chic touch to your home. The most prominent trait of this brushed stainless steel cabinet knob is the modern curve; and since it is available in 4 sizes, you will be sure to find just the right one. The smooth surface makes it easy to clean, so it will maintain its rich luster for the lifetime of your home. Just like all Omnia's stainless steel cabinet handles, the modern style pull will prove worthy of the exceptional standards that Omnia has sustained for more than 40 years.

Also available Smooth Curve Stainless Appliance Pull

Specifications of the Smooth Curve Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 4 Sizes:

    9450/96
    • Length: 3-3/4" (c.c)
    • Overall Length: 4-5/8"
    • Projection: 1-1/8"
    • Pull Diameter: 10 mm (.394")

    9450/128
    • Length: 5" (c.c)
    • Overall Length: 5-7/8"
    • Projection: 1-3/16"
    • Pull Diameter: 10 mm (.394")

    9450/192
    • Length: 7-5/8" (c.c)
    • Overall Length: 8-3/4"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Pull Diameter: 10 mm (.394")

    9450/320
    • Length: 12-5/8" (c.c)
    • Overall Length: 14-9/16"
    • Projection: 1-3/8"
    • Pull Diameter: 10 mm (.394")

Sold Individually
